name: Goyon visionary comics
description: Visionary hand-drawn comics: dense, symmetrical, saturated coloured-pencil worlds of masks, feathered figures, totems, flames and patterned rays, like pages from an illuminated sketchbook.
light: inner glow, colour itself as light, hot centres fading to dark edges
composition: symmetrical or radiating from a central mask or eye, every part filled, often a double-page spread
camera_or_medium: coloured pencil and felt pen on paper, sketchbook spreads and comic covers
texture_detail: dense pencil strokes, stacked rainbow bands, fine repeating ornaments, paper texture
subjects: a feathered mask radiating rainbow rays
a procession of totem figures in flames
a sketchbook spread with a giant eye
a mythic bird over a patterned city
